verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents broad programmatic coverage of admin functions. The Admin SDK covers user creation and listing, device actions, audit and usage reports, alerts, and SSO and email-routing settings; Cloud Identity API handles identity provisioning and dynamic groups; and Apps Script is explicitly positioned for automating Admin console tasks. However, nothing claims or demonstrates full UI parity, and several console features in the pack (Context-Aware Access policies, 2SV enforcement, mobile password requirements) appear only as Admin console help articles with no API equivalent shown. Missing for 10: an explicit or demonstrated UI/API parity claim, documented API coverage of security-policy settings (Context-Aware Access, 2SV, device password rules), end-user app (Docs/Gmail/Meet) API parity evidence, independent corroboration of coverage depth.
